title: call_seconds total adds with unchecked `+=` on i64 from TDLib durations
trigger: networkStatistics with huge call durations summed per group
effect: wraps silently in release (negative call time) / overflow panic in debug; panic-safety rule 5
fix: saturating_add

title: NotificationOutcome carries `clicked: bool` and `action: Option` that must agree (clicked == action.is_some())
trigger: any construction of NotificationOutcome that sets one without the other
effect: none today (single constructor sets both); two fields kept in step by hand
fix: drop `clicked`, derive from action.is_some() or make the outcome Option<NotificationAction>

title: thread-local RefCell borrow_mut held across UnreadMemo::get, which walks every chat via tray::badge_count
trigger: any re-entrant call to total_unread from inside badge_count (none today)
effect: BorrowMutError panic if badge counting ever calls total_unread; rule 6 (non-test RefCell borrow_mut spanning another module)
fix: compute outside the borrow (take the memo out, compute, put back) or use a Mutex-free copy of the key

title: persist() spawns its writer with std::thread::Builder instead of spawn_guarded
trigger: a panic inside with_file/write_json_atomic on the quill-notify-volumes thread
effect: panic not caught/logged by the shared guard (rule 11); spawn failure silently dropped so the volume is not saved
fix: crate::thread_guard::spawn_guarded

title: PaidGuard::screen fails open when its mutex is poisoned: the request is returned unscreened (and set_state silently skips)
trigger: a panic while the guard's State mutex is held, then any paid-chat send
effect: a send to a chat that charges Stars goes out without the user's confirmation, or with stale prices; contradicts the module's 'nothing is ever sent with a price the user has not agreed to'
fix: lock_or_recover (state is plain maps) so the screen still runs

title: unchecked i64 multiplication price*messages (also HeldSend::total line 44, PaidConfirm::total in paid_messages.rs:334)
trigger: huge price from TDLib times album/forward count
effect: wraps silently in release: the total written to paid_message_star_count or shown in the confirm box is wrong (rule 5)
fix: saturating_mul

title: PaidMessages::trust and trust_file are two public fields that must change together: every trust.trust()/forget() needs a hand-called trust_changed()
trigger: a caller that mutates `trust` (public field) and forgets trust_changed(), e.g. ui/paid_messages_tests.rs does; remember_paid_trust calls both by hand
effect: the trusted price is changed in memory but never written; the next start asks again (or keeps a price the user revoked)
fix: make trust private and expose trust()/forget() methods on PaidMessages that set TrustFile::Dirty themselves

title: PaidSave::begin overwrites an in-flight Saving(request) for the same target; the send-failure arm then clear()s the target, dropping the older save too
trigger: Remove Fee / Direct Messages Save pressed twice for one target (second send fails), or two boxes for the same user
effect: the target reads idle while the first request is still out; its error line is lost (fail() finds no Saving(request)) so a refused save shows nothing
fix: begin returns Err/ignored when the target is already Saving, or keep the older request and clear only the new one

title: PendingPaid::stars is 'the total of taps': two fields kept in step by hand in add and rollback
trigger: any new edit path that changes taps without stars
effect: none today; toast and balance reservation would drift from the taps
fix: derive stars from taps.iter().sum()

title: unchecked i64 `entry.stars += stars`, `p.stars -= tap.stars` and `now_ms + ACCUMULATE_MS`
trigger: extreme star counts / clock
effect: wrap in release (rule 5); negative total would remove the entry
fix: saturating_add/sub

title: A commit that cannot be sent or is refused (and a refused Undo) drops the local PendingPaid, but TDLib still holds the pending Stars from addPendingPaidMessageReaction
trigger: tap a Star reaction, commit send fails or TDLib answers an error to commit or remove (src/connect/paid_reaction.rs:118, state/domains/payments/error.rs:136-155)
effect: UI says 'Stars not sent' / no Undo toast, but the next Star tap on that message makes TDLib commit the old total plus the new one: Stars spent that the user was told were released
fix: on commit_unsent/refused keep an explicit Stage::Stuck(total) (or send removePending... and track that request) instead of forgetting the entry

title: PasskeysState::error is one free-floating Option<String> holding the failure of three different stages (list fetch, removal, registration), set and cleared by hand beside PasskeyList::Failed, removing and add
trigger: a removal fails, then Create Passkey is pressed; or a registration fails, then the list refetches (accept_list clears it); ui/security/passkeys.rs:229 and :246 clear it by hand from the delete confirmation
effect: an error line from one operation shows under another or lingers until an unrelated list answer clears it; PasskeyList::Failed has no reason of its own so `error` and the variant can disagree
fix: put the reason in the stage that failed (Failed{reason}, Removal::Failed, PasskeyAdd::Failed) and drop the shared field

title: PasskeysState::removing (Option<Removal>) is a one-at-a-time stage kept beside PasskeysState::list and generation: finish_remove must set removing=None, list=Stale and generation+1 together
trigger: any new exit from a removal (ok, error, lost) that clears removing but not the list or generation
effect: none today; UI reads removing.is_some() as 'busy' (ui/security/passkeys.rs:291,456,547) separately from the list stage
fix: fold the removal into PasskeyList (Removing{passkey, request, basis}) so the list stage and the removal are one value

title: CreationAsker{Dialog,Closed} is a two-variant enum beside NewChatCreation::outcome (None = in flight): the 'owner closed' flag of the create, and open_when_created/make_invite_link are bools copied from the kind
trigger: close the dialog while a create is out, or a create that is lost (request swept, never answered)
effect: a Closed create whose request is lost and never answered keeps its `creations` row for the session (abandon_new_chat only removes answered rows); the real stage (InFlight/Answered/Abandoned) is spread over asker and outcome
fix: enum CreationStage { InFlight{owner: Dialog|Closed}, Created(ChatId), Refused{..} } so abandoning is a transition and a lost request removes the row

title: For a supergroup/channel the Type step is shown from NewChatStage::Creating{progress: Created} until the first Save; NewChatStage::Type{save: Editing} is only reached after a refusal, so one step has two stage values
trigger: create a channel, then press Skip/Esc or Save on the type step: set_new_chat_stage swaps Creating for Subscribers/Type and abandons the create at that moment
effect: the create request id stays held by the stage while the user edits the link; Type{Editing} and Creating{Created} mean the same thing
fix: move to NewChatStage::Type{chat, save: Editing} as soon as the create is answered, and drop the request id there

title: GateFetch::Asking carries a time but not the RequestId (or the Premium state) of its ask; the answer is matched by user id only and stamped with the viewer's Premium at answer time
trigger: ask canSendMessageToUser as a non-Premium viewer, buy (or lose) Premium while it is out (updateOption is_premium), or let the 30 s ASK_TIMEOUT re-ask while the first request is still out
effect: an answer computed for the old Premium state is recorded as Known under the new one (record_answer in state/session_privacy_data.rs:132), so the composer gate is wrong until the 5 min refresh or the next Premium change; a late first answer overwrites the second
fix: Asking{request: RequestId, at, viewer_premium, before}; apply the answer only when its request id is the one held, with the Premium it was asked under

title: price_steps does `current + 10` / `current + 100` and step_for_price does `(*step - price).abs()` on i64 values from the server or a saved price without saturating
trigger: a saved price near i64::MAX or i64::MIN (corrupt option or hand-edited data)
effect: wraps in release (wrong slider steps), overflow panic in debug; rule 5
fix: saturating_add / saturating_sub + unsigned_abs

title: unlock() ignores a failed save of the bad-try counter (`let _ = save_config`), and the counter lives only in passcode.json that every attempt re-reads
trigger: passcode.json cannot be written (read-only folder, full disk) and a wrong passcode is typed repeatedly
effect: bad_tries never advances, so the tdesktop 5-30 s flood schedule never applies: unlimited guesses at PBKDF2 speed; the same swallowed error resets bad_tries on success
fix: keep the counter in memory too (UnlockState) and fail the attempt with PasscodeError::Io when the write fails

title: PeerQrBox::chosen (bool latch: stop following the saved theme) lives beside served, save: SaveStage and save_serial; lose_rights, picked and save() each reset or read it by hand together with save/served
trigger: a pick, then Sync with can_save=false (lose_rights sets chosen=false and re-shows served but leaves save untouched), then a new pick
effect: none found today; chosen, save.failed and served must be kept consistent by hand in picked/lose_rights/save
fix: one enum Theme{Following, Picked{choice, save: SaveStage}} where serial lives in SaveStage::Out

title: FreeUi::Requesting{request} does not hold the serial that matches its answer: FreeState::serial is a separate counter compared in PeerQrBox::free_answer, and drop_pending resets the stage by hand from sync/free_answer
trigger: sync() drops a pending permanent request (drop_pending) and a new request of the same kind starts before the old answer arrives
effect: works today because the serial is bumped in request(); the stage and the serial must be changed together by hand
fix: FreeUi::Requesting{ticket: FreeTicket} so the stage holds what its answer must carry

title: ThemeGifts keeps requested_at, serial and offset beside GiftsStage, and they are only meaningful in First/Listed(Loading); start/fail/refuse/accept change them together by hand
trigger: any new transition that changes stage without updating requested_at (fail() reads it to compute Waiting{at})
effect: none today; a failed page could schedule its retry from a stale requested_at
fix: GiftsRest::Loading{serial, requested_at} (and First{serial, requested_at}) so they live and die with the stage

title: baseline: FieldResult::finished (with invalid) mirrors Validation{state, finished}: two bools restating a ValidationState
trigger: a validator that returns finished with an Invalid state
effect: none today (all validators pair them correctly); focus-advance reads `finished`, the error style reads `invalid`
fix: carry Validation (state + Finished enum) through FieldResult instead of two bools

title: baseline: Validation::finished is a bool beside Validation::state; 'finished' is only legal with Valid
trigger: Validation::new(ValidationState::Invalid, true) is representable
effect: none today; every constructor sets it correctly
fix: enum Validation{Invalid, Incomplete, Valid{finished: bool}} or Valid/ValidFull

title: Open flags stars_open, gifts_open (and GramsHub::open) sit beside the dialog host and the stage state; each closer resets a different subset by hand
trigger: Open Stars, pick a transaction, close; open Received gifts, close; compare what close_stars/close_gifts/close_grams reset (tx_selected, gift_view, selected, withdraw) versus what stays (gifts_owner, gifts, tx stage)
effect: No bug today; the box open state has two sources (flag and DialogKind host) and a new field must be added to each closer by hand
fix: Derive open from the dialog host (DialogKind) and keep only data in the hub, or one enum StarsScreen/GiftsScreen/GramsScreen {Closed, Open(state)} replaced whole on close

title: Received-gifts list is eight fields kept in step by hand (owner, rows, total, cursor, page stage, notice, view, op); open_received_gifts clears them field by field and close_gifts clears only gift_view
trigger: Open gifts of user A, close, open gifts of chat B: open_received_gifts clears gifts, total, offset, page, notice, view one by one; after close_gifts the old owner and rows stay in the hub and gifts_are_mine() still answers for A
effect: No wrong output found today; any new field added to the list is stale across owners until someone adds it to open_received_gifts
fix: One GiftsScreen { owner, list: Listing<..>, view: GiftView, op: ListOp } value replaced whole when the owner changes or the box closes

title: Stars history is filter, rows, cursor, page stage, selection and balance kept in step by hand; set_star_transactions_filter resets five of them one by one
trigger: Switch the Stars tab All -> Incoming while a page is loading: filter, transactions, tx_offset, tx_selected and tx are each written at the call site (connect/premium_hub.rs set_star_transactions_filter); close_stars resets only tx_selected
effect: No wrong output found today; a new per-filter field is stale after a tab switch unless added at that call site
fix: StarsHistory { filter, list: Listing<StarTx> (rows, cursor, stage), selected } replaced whole on a filter change

title: premium_state is an Option with no stage: its request is fire-and-forget, an error answer is not handled, and the answer is matched by purpose, not request id
trigger: Open the Premium dialog while getPremiumState fails (offline blip, flood wait) but getPremiumFeatures succeeds; maybe_fetch_premium only asks again from premium.can_ask(), which is false once features are Ready
effect: premium_state stays None for the whole session: the Subscribe button loses the monthly price and plans, is_subscribed falls back to my_is_premium; it is also never refreshed after the user subscribes
fix: premium_state: Fetch<PremiumStateInfo> (or inside the same Fetch as features) with the request id in Loading, retried like premium_stickers, invalidated when Premium status changes

title: promo_request is a one-shot slot cleared only by the window that shows the ad's chat; if no window shows that chat it stays
trigger: Report a sponsored message that needs Premium (reducer sets promo_request), close the chat or window before the next frame; open the same chat later
effect: The Premium preview opens unprompted when the chat is next shown, or never if the chat is never shown again
fix: Give PromoRequest an owner (window/chat) and drop it with the chat's ChatUi or after one frame; or open the preview directly from the reducer's event queue

title: Grams peer lookup is four sets plus a counter kept in step: asked_users/asked_chats and missing_users/missing_chats (missing is a subset of asked) and peers_checked
trigger: A history row names an unknown user: connect/grams.rs grams_tick inserts into asked_users on send, the error arm inserts into missing_users; restart() resets peers_checked but leaves the four sets
effect: No bug found; per-peer stage (Unasked, Asked, Missing) is spread over two sets, and peers_checked must be reset with the list by hand
fix: HashMap<PeerKey, PeerAsk { Asked(RequestId), Missing }> plus the checked cursor inside the list value

title: Grams peer answers are matched by purpose (PeerUser/PeerChat) and a user id smuggled in PendingRequest.chat_id (ChatId(user_id)), not by a RequestId held in a stage
trigger: A history row names an unknown user; grams_tick sends getUser with send_grams_for(PeerUser, Some(ChatId(user_id))); apply_grams_error reads pending.chat_id as the user id
effect: A user id travels as a ChatId; any code that treats chat_id of a pending request as a chat (e.g. owner cleanup by chat) would act on the wrong object; the ask is also marked asked at send, not tied to its request
fix: PeerAsk::Asked(RequestId) in the peer map; the reducer compares the answer's id, and the key is an owner key (UserId) not a ChatId

title: A failed Settings balance probe is never asked again in the session: probe Failed is treated as asked, and the answer is matched by purpose only
trigger: Open Settings while the connection is flaky so getTonTransactions(limit 1) errors; grams_tick only probes while probe.is_idle(); reopen Settings later
effect: A user with a Grams balance never gets the My Grams row until restart (documented as intended, but the skip reason is avoiding a loop, not that the failure is final)
fix: Fetch::Failed re-asks on the next Settings open (not from the tick), with the RequestId in Loading and the reducer matching it

title: Collect box is withdraw: Option<GramWithdraw> beside withdraw_outcome: Option<WithdrawOutcome> (a one-shot slot for the UI) and the open flag; the outcome is cleared only when the password dialog's sync runs
trigger: Submit the password; the answer sets withdraw=None and withdraw_outcome=Some(Url) in the reducer; the UI takes it in grams_withdraw.rs sync (grams_mut().withdraw_outcome.take()); close_grams sets withdraw=None but does not clear a pending outcome
effect: No bug found; if the outcome lands in a frame where the dialog sync does not run (Grams closed in between), it waits and opens Fragment later
fix: GramWithdraw::{Password, SecurityCheck, Done(url), TooSmall} in one value taken once by its owner, cleared by close_grams

title: GramWithdraw::Password carries request: Option<RequestId> and error: Option<ExportError>; Idle is request None, Sending is request Some, and the error can sit beside a request
trigger: Submit with a wrong password (error Some), then submit again: submit_gram_withdrawal writes a new Password{request: Some, error: None} by hand; sending() and can_submit() are derived from the Option
effect: No bug today; Option used as a started flag, the two Options must be reset together at each write site
fix: Password { stage: Idle{error} | Sending(RequestId) }

title: GiftValueStage::Ready { open: bool } is the box-open flag in disguise: whether the box shows is also decided by the dialog host (DialogKind::GiftValue), and drop_orphaned_gift_value resets the slot to None from window upkeep, outside the stage's own transitions
trigger: Tap learn more on gift A (Loading), close A's box before the answer; drop_orphaned_gift_value (window_upkeep) sets hub.gift_value=None when !is_open && info().is_none(); Loading, Failed and Ready{open:false} all look the same to it
effect: Open state lives in two places; the by-hand reset in upkeep can drop a Loading/Failed lookup that a second window or the resale box still wants
fix: Stage Open(Loading|Failed|Ready) vs Closed(Known(info)) as one enum owned by the box host, dropped by the box's own close

title: LimitStore keeps each kind's stage in two parallel Vecs: answered (pair) and asked (Asked(request)/Refused), kept in step by hand
trigger: ensure_premium_limit: should_ask() reads both; apply_premium_limit retains out of both; note_asked/forget_asked/fail_ask edit asked alone
effect: No bug found; Unasked/Asked/Refused/Answered is derived from two collections, and an entry can be answered and asked until apply_premium_limit removes the ask
fix: HashMap<PremiumLimitKind, LimitState { Asked(RequestId), Refused, Answered(LimitPair) }>

title: CameraStream's stage is two AtomicBools (done, stop) plus child: Mutex<Option<Child>>: running, ended by ffmpeg, stopping are not one value
trigger: Unplug the camera: the reader thread sets done; or drop the panel: Drop sets stop and takes the child; done is also set when the thread exits because of stop, so finished() reads true for both
effect: No bug found; finished() cannot tell ffmpeg ended from owner stopped, and the child is held until Drop even after done
fix: Atomic u8 stage Running/Ended/Stopping (or a channel carrying one enum) read by the panel

title: Ping stage is split: PingStatus::Checking has no request id, the id lives in SettingsState::proxy_ping_requests, and the rotation's Probing{id} waits on pings[id]==Checking
trigger: Rotation probes proxy 2 (pings[2]=Checking, proxy_ping_requests[2]=r); the proxy list is refetched and pings are retained by id, but proxy_ping_requests is not; an answer is matched through the second map, a lost answer leaves Checking and the rotation waiting
effect: Auto-switch can wait on a Checking entry whose request was dropped (no timeout in rotation_step for Probing); the two maps can disagree after a list refetch or an edit
fix: PingStatus::Checking(RequestId) in one map; Probing carries the same RequestId and rotation_step compares it, with a timeout via the manual clock

title: ProxyFetch and ProxyMutation are two enums for one list that must change together (a mutation's success drops a Loading fetch and sets Stale; busy() joins them); ProxyMutation is a two-variant Idle/InFlight enum beside the fetch stage
trigger: Add a proxy while the first getProxies is out: proxy_mutation_succeeded overwrites fetch with Stale by hand, dropping the Loading request; mutation failure leaves fetch alone
effect: No bug found; correctness depends on every reducer writing both enums in the right order (FailedStale/Stale exist to patch gaps)
fix: ListOp-style ProxyList { stage: Idle|Loading(id)|Stale|Failed, op: Option<RequestId> } with transitions in one impl

title: LinkCheck::Done(PingStatus) can hold PingStatus::Checking, so the finished stage can say still checking
trigger: Type-level only: settle_link_check writes Done(Available|Unavailable); nothing prevents Done(Checking)
effect: No bug found
fix: Done(Result<u32 ms, ()>) or two variants Available(ms)/Unavailable on LinkCheck

title: Pinned-row drag is PinStage::Dragging(PinDrag{reorder}) and PinReorder.stage Dragging/Dropped: held vs sliding is a second stage nested under the first (src/pin_reorder.rs:77)
trigger: Release a dragged pinned chat: pin.reorder.release() flips the inner stage to Dropped while PinStage stays Dragging until settle() runs; callers check reorder.dragging().is_none() to tell the two
effect: No bug found; the same fact is two values and callers must consult both
fix: PinStage::{Idle, Pressed, Dragging(PinDrag), Sliding(PinDrag)} with the inner stage removed

title: validate_at adds now + POLL_DEADLINE_MIN_SECS and now + close_max unchecked; close_max comes from TDLib's poll_open_period_max option
trigger: TDLib reports a very large poll_open_period_max (i64 near MAX) and a date > 0 deadline is validated: now + close_max overflows (debug panic, release wrap that accepts a past deadline)
effect: Panic in debug builds, wrong validation in release; unlikely with real server values
fix: saturating_add for both sums

title: PsaAbout reader and writer use std::thread::spawn, which panics when the OS cannot start a thread
trigger: Open a promoted chat (start_load) or show the box (save_unsaved) under thread exhaustion
effect: the app panics instead of skipping the load or save
fix: thread_guard::spawn_guarded as the other helpers do; Load/Save fall back on Err

title: Load::Reading has no way out if the read thread never leaves its flags in the slot
trigger: The read thread panics before it stores (or the slot mutex is poisoned): Load stays Reading, poll_load returns false for ever
effect: a chat opened meanwhile sits in Toast::Waiting and never gets its one-time box; every later chat waits too (is_loaded false)
fix: Load::Reading carries a RequestId/Task and a Failed arm that becomes Done(empty)

title: Toast::Waiting(chat) is only valid while load != Done, kept in step by hand across two fields (load, toast)
trigger: restore() runs (demo or test path) while a chat waits: load = Done, toast stays Waiting with nothing left to resolve it unless poll_load also runs
effect: the waiting chat gets no box; the state has no owner for the Waiting stage
fix: one stage enum: Loading{waiting: Option<ChatId>} | Loaded{toast}

title: SaveState goes back to InSync before the write result is known and merge_save drops its error
trigger: Disk full or read-only app folder when the box is shown: save_unsaved marks InSync, the thread's write fails
effect: the seen flag is lost and the one-time box shows again next run; never retried
fix: SaveState::{InSync, Unsaved, Writing(task)} with Unsaved restored when the write fails

title: Pull holds stage flags reached, committed and holding beside Stage::Pulling: Pulling -> Reached -> Committed are three bools set by hand in handle() and frame()
trigger: A pull passes the threshold (reached), is released (committed); reached is cleared in handle on reverse and peak is reset next to it by hand
effect: every reader re-derives the stage from three flags and peak/has_next that must change together
fix: Stage::Pulling{Stretching, Ready{peak}, Released{ready}} instead of flags in Pull

title: ExpandRun::{Settled, Running} is a two-variant enum beside expand: Tween, whose animating(now) already says whether a frame is owed
trigger: start_expand sets Running, frame() clears it from expand.animating; reset() clears it by hand
effect: the stage is the old expand-running bool in disguise next to the Tween that owns the answer
fix: drop ExpandRun and read Tween::animating, or hold the Tween in an Option that ends when done

title: dwell_due: Option<u64> is a timer stage kept beside Pull.reached/amount and cleared by hand in handle(), frame() and reset()
trigger: Pull crosses the threshold with the finger down: dwell_due set; release or retreat clears it in three places
effect: a missed clear leaves a due dwell that marks a later pull reached (frame re-checks amount, so it is guarded by hand)
fix: Pull stage Stretching{dwell_due: Option<u64>} so the timer lives and dies with the stage

title: Watch::Watching has no way out when the watcher thread dies without calling ended()
trigger: The zbus watcher thread panics (spawn_guarded catches it) or is killed: Watch stays Watching, start_if_due never returns true again
effect: the screen-reader value stays at its last stored (or false) value for the rest of the run and is never re-read
fix: Watch::Watching holds the thread's JoinHandle/completion guard, so a dropped thread moves it to Ended

title: GlobalSearchFilters spreads one tab over scope, media and chat_type; SearchTab::of/apply keep them in step by hand and other writers set scope alone
trigger: search_hashtag (connect/search/mod.rs:353) and global_tag_search set filters.scope directly while media/chat_type stay from the tab the user was on
effect: impossible combinations (scope=PublicPosts with media=Photos, scope=Apps with chat_type=Channels) are representable; SearchTab::of silently ignores the extra field
fix: store SearchTab (plus date/archived) as the one value and derive scope/media/chat_type from it

title: rename_account does load, edit and save without the update_registry lock
trigger: Rename an account while a background removal finishes (finish_pending_delete) or another thread writes accounts.json
effect: The rename saves a stale registry over the other writer's change: a finished removal's pending record or a just-removed account can come back, or the other edit is lost
fix: Route rename_account through update_registry like every other writer (the doc on update_registry says it is the one way to write the list)

title: UI-thread spelling menu blocks on the dictionary parse lock
trigger: Start Quill or change the spelling languages, then right-click a word in the composer before the warm-up thread has parsed a large dictionary
effect: checker.is_correct and checker.suggestions (ui/spellcheck_ui.rs:557,565) call Entry::dict, which waits on the Mutex<Load> held for the whole parse, so the window freezes for the parse time (seconds for the big European dictionaries); the module doc says the UI thread never blocks on the parse
fix: Make the UI-thread path try_lock the Load and treat a parse in progress as a new Load::Parsing stage that answers no verdict or no suggestions

title: Timed-out spelling jobs stay queued on the COM thread and the UI thread waits up to 750 ms per call
trigger: Windows: open the suggestion menu repeatedly while the COM thread loads a cold dictionary or is stuck
effect: Each suggestions call blocks the UI up to CALL_WAIT, and every abandoned job still runs later on an unbounded channel, so a backlog builds and later answers are late
fix: Drop a job whose answer channel is gone before running it, and carry a generation or cancel token in Job

title: single_instance tests wait with wall-clock recv_timeout
trigger: Run the single_instance tests (lines 749, 755, 785)
effect: AGENTS.md says tests use no timeouts or wall-clock waits; these tests use rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)) on real sockets, so a hang is a 5 s wait and a slow machine can flake
fix: Block on recv with the fake clock and heartbeat already in the file, or drive the owner through the Launched helper

title: baseline: AppearancePrefs::ignore_battery_saving
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt
effect: A user setting (tdesktop ignoreBatterySaving) that matches the stage word list; it is read beside power_saving and the battery state
fix: Move it to scripts/implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason (a user setting), or fold it with power_saving into one PowerSaving value

title: Wallpaper source is wallpaper_rgb plus telegram_wallpaper, kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick a preset color (ui/appearance/new_accent_picker.rs:93,107 clears telegram_wallpaper), then apply a Telegram wallpaper (ui/wallpaper_preview.rs:265 sets it and clears the color)
effect: Both fields can hold a value at once (rgb Some and telegram true); the reader filters wallpaper_rgb with !telegram_wallpaper (new_accent_picker.rs:80), and a site that forgets the pairing shows a stale color chip or wallpaper
fix: enum WallpaperSource { Theme, Color(u32), Telegram } serialized with the same keys

title: Skip 04-085 does not hold: theme, day_theme, night_theme, auto_night and follow_omarchy are written together
trigger: choose_app_theme (ui/app_theme/mod.rs:370-385) sets follow_omarchy=false, the day or night slot, theme (Light or Dark) and, when it would switch straight back, auto_night=Off in one closure; resolve_app_theme reads follow_omarchy before theme_for(night)
effect: The skip says they are separate settings, but one action must change four of them in step, and its reason leans on 'about 150 readers rest on them' (effort). A site that writes one without the others leaves night mode, the slot and the theme choice disagreeing
fix: A ThemeSource { Omarchy, Slots { night_mode: NightMode, day, night } } with the file keys kept by a serde adapter

title: tdesktop WorkMode held as show_tray_icon, show_taskbar_icon and minimize_to_tray bools
trigger: Toggle the tray or taskbar switch (ui/tray_settings.rs:70-100 writes both bools from work_mode::toggle_tray/toggle_taskbar), or set minimize_to_tray with the tray icon off
effect: The combination both-off must be refused by the toggle helpers, and run-in-background only means something with a tray icon; the pairing lives in pure helpers and the tray_setting_switches gate, not in the type
fix: enum WorkMode { TrayOnly, TaskbarOnly, Both } plus CloseBehavior { Quit, RunInBackground } with the file keys kept by a serde adapter

title: remember_media_grouping and group_media are one choice held as two bools
trigger: MediaPrefs::default_grouping returns group_media only when remember_media_grouping is on, else true
effect: group_media is stored and edited even while remembering is off and then ignored; the composer must write it only when remembering is on
fix: enum MediaGrouping { AlwaysGrouped, Remembered { grouped: bool } }

title: Download stage is a raw AtomicU8 with RUNNING/CANCELLING/FINISHED constants beside received and the UI's DictDownload
trigger: ui/spell_dictionaries.rs starts a download: DictDownload::Running holds the Progress, whose stage the worker and the UI poll loop read
effect: The stage is a number, not an enum, and is_cancelled turns false once FINISHED, so the UI cannot tell a cancelled finish from a completed one except by the DownloadError it awaits; the stage is mirrored by DictDownload and RowDownload
fix: A #[repr(u8)] enum DownloadStage with TryFrom<u8>, loaded through one accessor, or a channel carrying Cancelled/Finished

title: A download cancelled just before install still installs, and nothing refreshes the list
trigger: Switch a downloading dictionary off after the worker passed its last is_cancelled check (spell_download.rs:149) and before install returns
effect: cancel_dictionary_download drops the Running stage and its task, so the answer is never applied: the files are installed but refresh_installed_dictionaries and set_spell_languages never run, and the row reads 'Download size' for a dictionary that is on disk until the list is next refreshed
fix: Keep the Running stage in a Cancelling variant that still receives the worker's answer and refreshes the installed list, ignoring only the language switch
